name: computation-workbench
description: Interactive Theory of Computation laboratory: PDA and Turing Machine engines with a React UI and Express API

scripts.dev: concurrently -n api,web -c blue,green "npm run dev -w @cw/api" "npm run dev -w @cw/web"
scripts.build: npm run build -w @cw/core && npm run build -w @cw/api && npm run build -w @cw/web
scripts.test: npm run test -w @cw/core && npm run test -w @cw/api
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck -w @cw/core && npm run typecheck -w @cw/api && npm run typecheck -w @cw/web
